Scenic Air Tour Over Yellowstone
and Grand Teton Parks
(Effective June 10, 1936)
National Parks Airways operates an attractive SCENIC AIR TOUR OVER
YELLOWSTONE and GRAND TETON PARKS. This tour will be conducted
in a large multi-motored Boeing Transport and provides a ONE AND ONE-
HALF HOUR FLIGHT over a region of diversified and spectacular scenic
attractions.
CONNECTS WITH NPA SERVICE The Scenic Air Tour operates from West
Yellowstone airport where the Tour Plane connects with regular NPA schedules.
ATTRACTIVE FARE: The Scenic Air Tour fare is $7.50 per passenger.
When the tour is purchased in conjunction with a Salt Lake to West
Yellowstone round-trip ticket an all-inclusive fare of $35.00 applies.
THE COURSE: NPA'S Scenic Air Tour begins at West Yellowstone airport
from which point the plane flies over the Cascades of the Firehole and south
over the Lower and Upper Geyser Basins where Old Faithful and other
famous geysers may be seen 1-
